verdict.rationale: Epic's privacy policy explicitly covers Unreal Engine and its developer tools, so data handling is a fair question for this product. However, the evidence only documents general retention and data-subject rights. Nothing in the pack shows a user-selectable storage region or a data-residency control, so the axis applies but is unevidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
